## How this portfolio was built

The site is a "Desktop OS" — a macOS-style shell (menubar, dock, draggable windows) wrapping the portfolio: a Finder-style file explorer, an AI chat terminal, and a retro Snake game.

- **Framework**: Gatsby 4 (React, static site generation) + TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v3; the Finder UI uses the Astryx design system
- **AI chat**: a Cloudflare Worker (in the same repo, `workers/chat-api`) that calls OpenRouter
- **Hosting**: GitHub Pages, deployed automatically by GitHub Actions
- **Source**: https://github.com/shravan097/shravan097.github.io
